description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultNotesRepository, verifying CRUD operations, synchronization behavior, local persistence, search functionality, reactive observations, and remote interaction logic.

classes.name: DefaultNotesRepositorySyncAndCrudTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing CRUD, synchronization, persistence, and reactive features of the DefaultNotesRepository.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes in-memory database, API, and repository before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the database after each test.

methods.name: crud_create_update_delete_are_reflected_in_observeNote_and_observeNotes
methods.description: Tests that create, update, and delete operations are correctly reflected in repository observations.

methods.name: offline_persistence_room_keeps_data_across_repository_instances
methods.description: Verifies data persistence across repository instances with in-memory Room database.

methods.name: sync_uploads_dirty_items_and_marks_clean
methods.description: Checks that dirty notes are uploaded and marked clean after sync.

methods.name: sync_last_write_wins_does_not_overwrite_local_when_local_is_newer_than_remote
methods.description: Ensures local updates are retained when local data is more recent than remote during sync.

methods.name: sync_tombstone_deletion_is_uploaded_and_purged_locally_and_visible_to_remote
methods.description: Validates tombstone (deletion) propagation and local purging after sync.

methods.name: search_escapes_like_wildcards_percent_and_underscore
methods.description: Verifies search query handling for literal '%' and '_' characters in titles.

methods.name: observeNotes_is_reactive_emits_when_item_changes_to_match_filter
methods.description: Tests reactive observation of notes when items change to match a filter query.
